# `SettleBegin`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

The guide controller started a settle phase.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, socket_json_guider_server_event::NotifySettleBegin @0x6d4c0 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit counterpart present |

Sent when the guide controller starts settling, for example after a guide start or dither (INFERRED from the controller role). Typically followed by Settling progress events and one SettleDone, but that sequence is not guaranteed. Sent by the guider process (zwoair_guider) on its TCP 4400 event server to every retained connection (G/all). The main imager process, which is a client of 4400, recognises event lines and forwards them unchanged onto TCP 4700 (I/all), so 4700 clients also receive it; the auxiliary imager process deliberately does not forward 4400 events. The imager's forwarding test is lexical (the exact text "Event":" in the line). Family N (notification): Event and Timestamp only, no state, code or error. No Android app consumer is established for this name. Ordering against RPC replies and other guider events is not guaranteed; no sequence number, replay or fixed cadence exists. Runtime reachability of the retained guiding functionality on every model is unresolved.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"SettleBegin"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, notify - Static example (READ shape, not captured):

```json
{"Event":"SettleBegin","Timestamp":"1234.123456789"}
```
